findings.text: The corollary assumes the planned changes suffice to preserve `Database.Valid`, but an empty valid table with a generated INTEGER column marked as its rowid alias accepts an INSERT that produces rowid 1 and alias value 0, breaking `RowsAliased`. Fix: Record this counterexample and resolve the missing alias-schema invariant and its preservation obligations before requiring the corollary.

The status cites local Lean and SQLite probes as evidence, contrary to `AGENTS.md`, which permits only Nix-check results in status files. Fix: Replace the local results with Nix-check evidence or remove the measured claims and describe the source-code observations.
